MINI MINUTES: This cause came on as re-assigned by the Master Calendar Dept. 206 for Prove-Up Hearing/Court Trial this day.
Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
David Mendez, Esq. for Plaintiff: B.D. Thakor and Plaintiff's witness: Anil Patel, were sworn and direct examined.
No appearance by the Defendant: Tammy Sue Sarmento.
Exh. 1 - Threeday Notice dtd. 10-6-04--------ID/EVID.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defendant: Tammy Sue Sarmento as follows:
Restitution and possession of the premises located at 56 Mason St., #312, San Francisco.
Rent and Per Diem Damages of $3,530.00
No Attorney's Fees.
Costs per cost bill.
Counsel stipulated for the return of the Exhibit in open court.
Judgment signed in open court.
